title: All-Items
description: All-Items Mod find all Items in Minecraft also the difficult items(except all Items that need Admin Permissions)
body:
# All-Items

**Track every item you find in survival Minecraft!**

All-Items is a client-side Fabric mod that tracks which items you've discovered in survival mode. It displays a customizable HUD showing your progress, plays sounds on new discoveries, and provides a full GUI to browse your collection.

---

## Features

### HUD
- **Progress display** — percentage, found/total count, missing items
- **Compact mode** — all info on a single line
- **Last item icon** — shows the most recently found item with configurable scale
- **Progress bar** — solid or multi-stop gradient (horizontal, vertical, diagonal, radial, angled)
- **Dimension & biome display** — show current dimension and biome on the HUD
- **Completion ETA** — estimates time to 100% based on your current rate
- **Fraction mode** — show `found/total` instead of percentage
- **HUD scaling & opacity** — scale the entire HUD and adjust transparency
- **Auto-hide** — HUD hides automatically after a configurable idle time
- **Fade animation** — smooth fade-in effect when a new item is found
- **Pulse effect** — brief flash on new discoveries
- **Separator line** — optional line between HUD sections
- **Move mode** — reposition the HUD with arrow keys (Shift for fine-tuning)

### Visual Customization
- **Title text** — alignment (left/center/right), scale, color, shadow toggle
- **Missing text** — custom color
- **Background** — toggle, color, corner radius, padding, blur effect
- **Border** — toggle, thickness, color, edge snapping in move mode
- **Bar** — height, gradient mode & colors (multi-stop editor with preview)
- **Item** — background behind item icon, glint effect on new finds

### Notifications
- **Chat message** — fully customizable template with rich text (§-codes), variables: `%item%`, `%count%`, `%total%`, `%percent%`, `%prefix%`
- **ActionBar message** — same template system
- **Title overlay** — big screen title on new finds
- **Toast notification** — Minecraft system toast
- **Chat cooldown** — prevents message spam

### Sound
- **14 note block instruments** — harp, bass, bell, chime, bit, banjo, pling, xylophone, iron xylophone, didgeridoo, guitar, snare, hat, cowbell
- **Volume & pitch** — fully adjustable
- **Cooldown** — prevents sound spam
- **Master toggle** — quick disable from settings
- **Milestone sound** — separate instrument/volume/pitch for milestone events

### Tracking
- **Automatic detection** — scans your inventory for unobtained items
- **Per-world saves** — separate progress per singleplayer world or server
- **Global tracking mode** — progress shared across all worlds
- **Session counter** — tracks items found in the current play session
- **Discovery time** — records when each item was first found
- **Item count** — tracks how many times each item has been collected
- **Recent finds** — last 50 discoveries stored
- **Milestones** — special notifications at 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 90%, and 100%
- **Pause tracking** — temporarily pause discovery detection
- **Blacklist/Whitelist** — filter specific items by ID
- **Auto-save** — configurable interval (in ticks)
- **Auto-backup** — automatic save file backups

### Survival-Only Filter
Items that cannot be obtained in vanilla survival are excluded:
- Creative-only blocks (barrier, bedrock, command blocks, etc.)
- Spawn eggs
- Technical blocks (spawners, portals, structure blocks, etc.)
- Test blocks, infested blocks
- Chorus plant, dirt path, farmland, frogspawn, suspicious blocks, calibrated sculk sensor, budding amethyst, player head

### GUI (Chest Inventory)
- **Grid view** — browse all tracked items in a chest-style interface
- **Color-coded slots** — green for found, red for missing
- **Filters** — All / Missing / Found
- **Search** — filter by item name or ID
- **Sort modes** — A-Z, Found First, Recent, Count
- **Tooltip on hover** — shows item ID, status, count, discovery time
- **Session counter** — displayed in the progress bar area

### Commands (`/ai`)
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ai` | Show quick progress summary |
| `/ai overlay` | Toggle HUD on/off |
| `/ai gui` | Open item inventory |
| `/ai settings` | Open settings screen |
| `/ai customize` | Open HUD customization |
| `/ai move` | Enter HUD move mode |
| `/ai stats` | Show detailed statistics |
| `/ai missing` | List all missing items |
| `/ai recent` | Show recent finds |
| `/ai export` | Copy JSON export to clipboard |
| `/ai pause` | Pause/resume tracking |
| `/ai compact` | Toggle compact mode |
| `/ai sound` | Toggle sound on/off |
| `/ai chat` | Toggle chat messages |
| `/ai actionbar` | Toggle actionbar messages |

### Keybinds
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| R | Toggle HUD overlay |
| N | Toggle sound |
| G | Open items GUI |
| M | Open settings |
| P | Enter move mode |
| (unbound) | Pause tracking |
| (unbound) | Toggle compact mode |

---

## Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 26.1.2
- **Fabric Loader:** 0.16+
- **Fabric API:** Required

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Put Fabric API and All-Items in your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game — the mod activates automatically
